sections.heading: How we evaluate
sections.body: SoftwareGlimpse evaluates ecommerce products on ease of use, storefront/commerce fit, catalog and order depth, checkout conversion, integrations, omnichannel readiness, scalability, value, and AI assistance. Hosted SaaS platforms, open-source carts, website builders, omnichannel POS bundles, dropshipping sourcing tools, and print-on-demand fulfillment networks are scored inside their job cluster — never forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.

sections.heading: Evidence limitations
sections.body: This draft may rely on fixture research. It is not indexable and does not claim hands-on testing or verified live pricing.
